C13 is 5.69mm from U3, the IC it decouples -- beyond the 5.00mm tether search radius, so decap_distance never measured it against the 4.73mm limit. That limit was derived from the caps INSIDE the radius, so it says nothing about this one

U6: 5 of 8 connected pads sit on a row facing the east/north edge (1.48mm) with no partner beyond -- their nets can only leave along the edge strip or under the part
